name: cs-copilot
description: Ridgeline Supply Co. customer service copilot (fictional company, synthetic data). Answers questions about a customer's orders, shipments and invoices with evidence from the CRM, ERP, carrier and AR systems (read through a governed MCP gateway) and cites customer service policy. Proposes CRM cases; a human approves every case before it is created. Acts with the caller's own identity: send a Keycloak access token for your client (client credentials).

skills.name: Order, shipment and invoice status
skills.description: Where is a customer's order, has it shipped, when will it arrive, is it late against the SLA, and what is still open on the customer's account. Needs an order number or an account name or alias. Reps see only accounts in their own region; a lead sees all.
examples: Where is order SO-104233 for Summit Contractors?
Summit Contractors says SO-104233 hasn't arrived and they were billed. What's going on?

skills.name: Billed but not delivered
skills.description: Compares what a customer was invoiced with what was delivered (tracking and proof of delivery) and recommends the next step from the billing dispute policy. Explains; never changes invoices, prices, credit or payment terms.
examples: Pinecrest Hardware says they were invoiced for SO-104301 but only got half of it.

skills.name: Propose a CRM case
skills.description: Proposes a CRM case (for example a late delivery) for a CS lead. A human approves or rejects it in the approval workflow before anything is written; reps cannot create cases.
examples: Open a case for Summit Contractors about the late delivery of SO-104233 and confirm the new delivery window.

keycloak.description: Keycloak realm ridgeline, audience ridgeline-gateway; the token is passed through to the gateway.
